piston-engine-oil.name: AeroShell Oil W 15W-50
piston-engine-oil.description: Engineered for all-season performance and advanced engine protection, AeroShell Oil W 15W-50 is a premium semi-synthetic multigrade oil formulated by blending high-quality mineral base stocks with over 50% synthetic hydrocarbon fluids. Eliminates seasonal oil changes while delivering rapid cold-weather startup flow and high-temperature film strength. Features ashless dispersant technology, non-metallic anti-rust additives, and the Lycoming LW 16702 anti-wear additive to protect critical camshafts and lifters.
piston-engine-oil.applications: All-season use in aviation piston engines requiring anti-wear, anti-rust, and sludge prevention.

piston-engine-oil.name: AeroShell Oil Sport Plus 4
piston-engine-oil.description: Engineered in direct partnership with ROTAX, AeroShell Oil Sport Plus 4 is the first dedicated aviation engine oil specially developed for four-stroke light sport piston engines. Utilizing high-quality hydrocarbon base stocks enriched with synthetic technology, it accommodates lower cylinder head temperatures and low oil consumption while maintaining exceptional stability across all operating climates and fuel types.
piston-engine-oil.applications: Four-stroke light sport piston engines (including ROTAX 912 and 914 series), automotive-derived engines (carbureted, fuel-injected, turbocharged) that cannot run on traditional ashless dispersant oils.

piston-engine-oil.name: AeroShell Oil 100
piston-engine-oil.description: Blended from high viscosity index mineral base stocks, AeroShell Oil 100 is an ashless straight mineral oil designed for certified four-stroke aircraft reciprocating piston engines and radial engines calling for non-dispersant lubricants. Contains minimal additives beyond antioxidants and targeted pour-point depressants for low-temperature fluidity.
piston-engine-oil.applications: Break-in period of new or recently overhauled aviation piston engines to allow proper ring seating (excluding Porsche).

piston-engine-oil.name: AeroShell Oil W100 Plus
piston-engine-oil.description: Combining premium single-grade ashless dispersant performance with advanced protection, AeroShell Oil W100 Plus is an SAE Grade 50 piston engine oil designed for single-grade reliability with elite anti-wear and anti-corrosion defense. Incorporates the proven AeroShell W additive package, additional anti-corrosion chemistry, and the Lycoming LW 16702 anti-wear additive to protect camshafts and lifters during idle periods and reach TBO. Fully compatible with other approved aviation piston engine oils.
piston-engine-oil.applications: Certified aviation piston engines requiring SAE Grade 50 protection.

piston-engine-oil.name: AeroShell Oil W120
piston-engine-oil.description: Delivering high-viscosity non-ash dispersant performance, AeroShell Oil W120 combines select high viscosity index mineral base stocks with non-metallic additives to ensure superior stability, dispersancy, and anti-foaming protection with zero metallic ash residues. Maintains engine cleanliness, keeps internal components sludge-free, reduces oil consumption, and protects critical parts against scuffing to help reach TBO.
piston-engine-oil.applications: Heavy-duty, four-stroke certified reciprocating aircraft engines operating under hot conditions or high stress.

piston-engine-oil.name: AeroShell Oil W100
piston-engine-oil.description: Pioneering non-ash dispersant technology for aviation piston engines, AeroShell Oil W100 combines high viscosity index base stocks with non-metallic additives to ensure exceptional stability, dispersancy, and anti-foaming protection. Eliminates metallic ash residues to prevent combustion chamber deposits and spark plug fouling, keeping engines sludge-free, reducing oil consumption, and protecting against scuffing to reach TBO.
piston-engine-oil.applications: Certified four-stroke reciprocating piston engines (including fuel-injected and turbocharged models).

turbine-engine-oil.name: Eastman Turbo Oil 2380
turbine-engine-oil.summary: High thermal stability for modern turbine engines.
turbine-engine-oil.description: Eastman Turbo Oil 2380 is a 5 cSt synthetic turbine oil used where high thermal stability and reliable oil consumption are required.
turbine-engine-oil.applications: Commercial and military turbine engines approved for this grade.

speciality-fluids.name: AeroShell Fluid 3
speciality-fluids.summary: Balanced thermal stability for reliable turbine performance.
speciality-fluids.description: AeroShell Fluid 3 is a general-purpose mineral lubricating oil for aircraft instruments and general airframe use.
speciality-fluids.applications: Instruments, general airframe lubrication, and other approved light-duty uses.
